title: Leaf-free first-half prefix curve for equicorrelations
statement: For A=(1-rho)I+rho 11^T with -1/(n-1)<rho<1, mu=lambda_min(A), and every 1<=t<=ceil(n/2), the exact random-prefix decrease matrix satisfies J_t(A)>=(t mu/n)A^{-1}. The same holds under diagonal sign conjugacy.
open_objections: The proof uses the two-isotypic equicorrelation symmetry and does not extend to a general correlation matrix.
No Lean formalization, priority audit, or outside-human validation exists.
